about: The declarative inventory of every runnable verification in this repo. HAND-AUTHORED, not generated: `ci` values are facts read out of the workflow and `purpose` text is quoted from the `//`-prefixed sibling keys in the root package.json. `scripts/run-gates.mjs --check-ci` is the drift gate that keeps `ci` honest in both directions.
ciScope: The `ci` field names jobs in .github/workflows/v2-checks.yml ONLY. release.yml and ai-readiness-eval.yml are deliberately out of scope: the first publishes, the second is label-gated real-spend. A gate that runs only in those workflows carries ci:null and says so in `note`.

needsVocabulary.none: Runs on a bare clone with nothing but node. No install, no build.
needsVocabulary.install: Needs `pnpm install` (node_modules present at the repo root).
needsVocabulary.tokens-v5: Needs the Style Dictionary v5 brand/mode bundles - libs/al-web-components/styles/dist-v5/css/.
needsVocabulary.libs: Needs the built component libraries - libs/al-web-components/dist and libs/al-react/dist (pnpm run build).
needsVocabulary.fixtures: Needs the built example-app / story fixtures (pnpm run build:fixtures, build:story-fixture).
needsVocabulary.docs: Needs the built docs site at dist/docs (pnpm --filter al-app-docs build).
needsVocabulary.browser: Needs a Playwright chromium install (pnpm exec playwright install chromium).
needsVocabulary.git-history: Needs real git history and a base ref to diff against - shallow clones and detached snapshots cannot satisfy it.
needsVocabulary.clean-tree: Needs an uncommitted-change-free working tree for the paths it diffs; a dirty tree makes the check report someone else's edits.
needsVocabulary.capture: Needs the docs ground-truth PNGs under .altitude/figma-sync/shots/docs (pnpm run capture:docs).
needsVocabulary.canvas: Needs extracted Figma canvas contracts under .altitude/figma-sync/**/canvas-contracts/. These are GITIGNORED live observations - absent on a clone, which is why the gates that read them cannot be CI gates.
needsVocabulary.figma-shim: Needs the Figma MCP shim reachable on 127.0.0.1:9401 (scripts/figma-atoms/mcp-shim.mjs, Figma desktop running).
needsVocabulary.network: Needs outbound network access, or a deployed URL to check.

tiers.fast: No build required. needs are a subset of {none, install, git-history, clean-tree}.
tiers.build: Requires built output of some kind - tokens, CEM, libraries, fixtures, docs, a browser, or captured shots.
tiers.live: Requires something outside the repo - the Figma shim, a live canvas extraction, a saved Figma export, or the network.

fields.id: The npm script name where one exists; otherwise a stable slug for a CI step that runs `node scripts/...` with no alias (npmScript:null).
fields.npmScript: The root package.json script name, or null when the gate has no alias.
fields.purpose: One line. Quoted or condensed from `purposeSource` - never invented.
fields.purposeSource: Where `purpose` came from: package.json-comment | workflow-step-name | script-header.
fields.needs: Prerequisite tokens from needsVocabulary. The runner probes each and NAMES every skip.
fields.blocking: true = a failure fails the run. false = warning tier; reported loudly, exit code unchanged.
fields.ci: The exact `name:` of the v2-checks.yml job(s) this runs inside, as a string or array; null when nothing in that workflow invokes it; "unknown" when it has not been determined.
fields.ciVia: When ci is null but the gate still runs in CI transitively, the gate id that pulls it in.
fields.note: Anything a reader would otherwise get wrong.
fields.autorun: false = never selected by --tier/--group; it must be named with --only. Used for builds and for anything that MUTATES a committed artifact.
